Oliver — thanks for the quick read and the asks. High level response:

- 45-day pilot: we can extend to 45 days if Acme signs a 12-month committed usage agreement after pilot completion (min commit: $250k ARR equivalent or the token-commit schedule below).
- Ramp & discounts: we propose milestone-linked discounts (early ramp bonus + committed discount tiers). I attached a draft MAP (Acme-MAP-v3.pdf) and our pricing worksheet (redwood-pricing-sheet.xlsx).

Draft milestones (high level):
1) Kickoff & baseline eval (day 0–14) — success criteria: response latency <300ms p95 on sample suite.
2) Integration & feature tests (day 15–45) — success criteria: 5 production-ready routes + 2k qps simulated.
3) Pilot completion & commit (day 46–60) — if commit signed, apply committed discount (tiered).
4) Q1 ramp (month 1–3 post-commit) — ramp milestones trigger incremental credits.

Discount ask summary:
- Standard committed discount: 15% at $250k ARR equivalent commit
- Tier 2: 25% at $500k ARR
- Exceptional one-time ramp credit (deal-specific): up to 35% applied to first 3 months if Acme commits to >$750k ARR and provides a firm Q1 usage schedule.

Per Redwood policy, any deal with an effective discount above 30% requires VP + CFO review and CEO sign-off. I'm copying Marcus and Laura to start the internal approval thread.
